LatencyForge Opsystems

Account snapshot: mid-sized edge infra vendor building sub-50ms chat + high-QPS embedding lookups for personalization. Heavy cost sensitivity; run-rate economics matter — willing to trade model size for quantization if quality holds.

Discovery summary:
- 2026-01-27: Intro call (Maya + Diego) — they described production traffic: 1200 RPS peak for embeddings, 300 QPS for chat at 256 token avg. Expect 3x growth in 6 months.
- 2026-02-18: Technical deep-dive (Diego, infra engs) — asked about continuous batching, dynamic batching policies, prefix/KV caching, and kernel selection for sequence lengths ~128-512. Fireflies: ff-2026-02-18-8192.
- 2026-03-05: Security sync with Priya + security team — need SOC2 + SSO/SAML + KMS + audit logs for Private deployment. Fireflies: ff-2026-03-05-1024.

Requirements & constraints (customer language / notes):
- Latency target: p95 <= 40ms for chat single-turn, tail sensitivity (sub-ms jitter desirable).
- Embeddings: <= 20ms p95 per vector for 128-d use, batching strongly desired to reduce unit cost.
- Throughput: sustained 1k-1.5k RPS embeddings; burst to 5k RPS for marketing spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: target < $0.002 per embedding request (target unit cost after batching/quantization).
- Model preferences: open Llama-variant family acceptable; willing to evaluate 4-bit / 6-bit quantized variants if accuracy degradation < 1.5% on eval set.
- Routing/fallback: need graceful fallback to smaller quantized model or cross-region replica during capacity limits.
- Observability: per-route token cost, per-request trace id mapping, and rollback hooks for canary.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: baseline perf test using Redwood hosted small instance; capture seq-length distribution and cold-starts. (Deliverable: perf-report-v1)
- Week 1: run Dedicated pool with continuous batching + KV cache enabled; run synthetic workload mirroring production qps/seq dist. (Deliverable: p95/p99 latency curves, cost-per-token model)
- Week 2: quantized model tests (4-bit / 6-bit) with eval prompt-set; measure accuracy delta vs baseline and throughput gains. (Deliverable: quality vs cost tradeoff matrix)
- Acceptance criteria: p95 <= 45ms chat, embedding p95 <= 25ms, cost per embedding <$0.002 after batching.

Open technical questions (SE action items):
- Provide kernel selection report for their GPU types (A10/A100 mix).
- Confirm autoscaling buffer config for bursts and canary rollback latency impact.
- Provide recommended batching policy (max latency vs max batch size) and expected cost delta.

Sales notes / quotes:
- Customer: "We can accept a small quality drop if the per-request cost halves — but must not break top-k rerank accuracy."
- Procurement/Finance: wants 12-month pricing with reserved Dedicated capacity option and an SLA for p95 p99.

Next steps (short):
- SE Diego to deliver POC test plan and synthetic workload script by 2026-03-15 (done in sprint).
- Maya to schedule exec demo week of 2026-03-22.
- Security deliverable: Redwood to share SOC2 artifacts + on-prem KMS integration checklist (link shared in Drive).
